name: The Echoverse
description: The Echoverse is the Theorist's mirrored replacement Multiverse, a copy of the Multiverse's planes built without what he deemed too great an evil.

status.text: As of September 2026 the Echoverse is collapsing, being devoured by Emrakul as the doubles of planes fade.

"Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The guide introduces Jace's attempt to rewrite reality and the Echoverse.
timeline.quote: Jace Beleren, Planeswalker and mind-mage, is attempting to rewrite reality with his own vision for existence.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2026.

timeline.summary: Only the Theorist remains, erasing memories and puppeteering enemies without regard for free will.
timeline.quote: Now, the Theorist is all that remains

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2026.

timeline.summary: The Theorist calculates probabilities and excises persons or events from planes' histories to build the Echoverse.
timeline.quote: the Theorist calculates probabilities and works to excise elements (a person, an event) from a plane's history.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam is made and wakes to find an exhausted man who tells her that her name is Tamira but who she is is up to her.
timeline.quote: "Your name is Tamira, but who you are is up to you."

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 1: Tam, Alive" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2026.

timeline.summary: He tells her she is a person in progress.
timeline.quote: "In progress. Yeah. You're a person in progress."

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 1: Tam, Alive" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2026.

timeline.summary: The Theorist reveals he plans to overwrite the existing Multiverse by laying the Echoverse over it.
timeline.quote: "Correct. We need to overwrite the existing Multiverse to make this one stable."

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 1: Tam, Alive" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam shows Liliana the orrery copy and asks what overwriting will mean; Liliana explains it will suffocate the original Multiverse.
timeline.quote: "It won't tear them apart, but layering one Multiverse on another will smother the souls of everyone in the original.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The monster demands to be shown where Tam's Multiverse is and offers to rid her of it; Tam escapes.
timeline.quote: Run! Tam can't help the scream she lets out

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 4: Oh, Sweetie" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Vraska enters the Echoverse through a mage-ring and finds details made for her, like the leaves matching her eyes.
timeline.quote: the yellow in the tree leaves is the exact same shade as her eyes

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 4: Oh, Sweetie" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Vraska meets Chandra, Ajani and Garruk after they slog through ooze, and they argue about Liliana, whom Garruk wants revenge on.
timeline.quote: "Stand aside and permit me my revenge," Garruk says with deadly calm. "The witch cursed me."

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 4: Oh, Sweetie" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The overlay's threads fade as the knife in his heart ends the false Multiverse's tether.
timeline.quote: Above, the orrery has paused, the threads tying the two Multiverses together fading with the beating of his heart.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Vraska holds Jace's body and weeps as Chandra and Ajani embrace her; Liliana kneels and mourns him.
timeline.quote: Vraska holds the body of her beloved and weeps.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Jace's spark rises from his chest as a blue light and shoots through an open window; Liliana demands to know what he did.
timeline.quote: the spark continues its climb up, out of his chest

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Emrakul opens her mouth and begins devouring the Echoverse, and doubles of planes fade.
timeline.quote: As the mirrored plane shakes and sputters, it begins to fade.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The tower fades, and the doppelgangers of Chandra, Garruk and Ajani step out of a portal and attack.
timeline.quote: One of the portals in the center of the sanctum glows, and out step their doppelgängers.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Vraska turns Ajani's double to stone with her gaze.
timeline.quote: Stone overtakes fur, and the doppelgänger dies with a snarl on his face.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Liliana senses Emrakul overhead and deduces that Jace's spark went to one specific body.
timeline.quote: Liliana remembers the spark emerging from Jace's chest, flying out the window, seeking a body.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The doubles vanish, and a mage-ring appears as a way home; Ajani and Chandra planeswalk away.
timeline.quote: Liliana sees a flash of light as the two of them planeswalk away.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Garruk blames Liliana's curse and asks if she knows the twins; she says she cares for them, and he planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: "I will not forgive you, witch, but tell me the truth and I will spare you. Do you know the twins?"

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Liliana returns for Vraska and Jace's body and they haul him through the mage-ring away from the false Multiverse.
timeline.quote: Together, Liliana and Vraska haul Beleren's body through the mage-ring, away from the false Multiverse.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Jace resolves to create a new reality that erases the trauma and suffering of the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: He has resolved to create a new reality instead

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Jace creates Tam, who becomes his spy and agent to gather the final pieces for the new reality.
timeline.quote: Created by Jace Beleren, Tam has dutifully followed and learned from her teacher.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Ajani carves a trail of carnage across the Echoverse seeking revenge for his brother.
timeline.quote: He carved a trail of carnage across the Echoverse as he sought revenge against those he judged responsible for his brother's death.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

relations.note: The Theorist builds the Echoverse as a copy of the Multiverse.
relations.quote: To create a Multiverse free of pain and suffering

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2026.

relations.note: The Theorist made the Echoverse, his grand project.
relations.quote: The Theorist did such a magnificent job of replicating the Multiverse he came from while clipping away its cruelties.
